# Marker identification workflow

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

A complete workflow for identifying and visualizing cluster markers.

## Workflow

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Visualize clusters
p1 <- SCpubr::do_DimPlot(sample = sample,
                         label = TRUE)

# Show marker expression
p2 <- SCpubr::do_DotPlot(sample = sample,
                         features = markers)

# Combined view
p1 / p2
```
